products.name: Piezo Bridge Pickup for Cigar Box Guitar
products.shortDescription: Hand-made hardwood bridge base with a built-in piezo disc, pre-wired lead, and an ungrooved saddle that fits 3- or 4-string cigar box guitars.
products.description: A hand-made hardwood bridge base with a piezo disc set into the underside and a twisted red/black lead ready to solder to an output jack. An ungrooved saddle is supplied in the routed slot on top, so the same bridge works on both 3- and 4-string builds — groove the saddle yourself for your string count if you want. Photos show a 3-string example.

specs.Pickup: Piezo disc mounted under the bridge, two slotted mounting/through holes
specs.Saddle: Ungrooved saddle included in the top slot — suitable for 3- or 4-string guitars
specs.Compatibility: Works with 3- and 4-string cigar box guitars (one ungrooved saddle)

products.installNotes: From the photos: drill a hole in the top under the bridge position to pass the lead into the box, set the bridge with the piezo side down over the hole, solder the lead to a 1/4" output jack mounted in the top or side, then fit the ungrooved saddle and string up (groove the saddle for your string count if desired).
